subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian states has the highest elevation point in India (excluding POK)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanchenjunga**, located in the state of **Sikkim**, is the highest elevation point in India (excluding Pakistan-occupied Kashmir). It stands at a towering height of **8,586 meters**, making it the third-highest mountain in the world.
 
• This peak is part of the **Himalayan mountain range** and lies on the border of India and Nepal. The majority of Kanchenjunga's massif lies within Sikkim, India.
 
• Sikkim's unique geographical location, surrounded by the Eastern Himalayas, contributes to the presence of such high-altitude peaks. *Hence, Sikkim is the correct answer.*
 
• Other states like **Himachal Pradesh**, **Uttarakhand**, and **Arunachal Pradesh** also host high-altitude peaks, but none of them surpass Kanchenjunga in terms of elevation.
 
• In Himachal Pradesh, the highest peak is **Reo Purgyil** at an elevation of **6,816 meters**, while in Uttarakhand, **Nanda Devi** stands at **7,816 meters**, and Arunachal Pradesh features **Kangto** at **7,042 meters**.
 
• Despite these impressive peaks, **Sikkim's Kanchenjunga** remains the highest elevation point in India (excluding POK) and is internationally recognized as a key landmark of the country. *Hence, the other options are incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kanchenjunga:**

 
 
• **Kanchenjunga** is sacred to the people of Sikkim and is considered the guardian deity of the state. Climbing the peak is restricted due to its cultural and spiritual significance.
 
• It is a part of the **Greater Himalayas** and is renowned for its biodiversity, hosting rare species like the **red panda** and **snow leopard**.
 
• Kanchenjunga’s name means “The Five Treasures of Snows,” referring to its five distinct peaks, which symbolize the treasures of gold, silver, gems, grain, and sacred texts.
 
 
 
• **Other High Peaks in India:**
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh:** **Reo Purgyil**, at an elevation of **6,816 meters**, is the highest peak in the state and lies in the Zanskar Range.
 
• **Uttarakhand:** **Nanda Devi**, at **7,816 meters**, is the second-highest peak in India after Kanchenjunga. It is part of the Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh:** **Kangto**, at **7,042 meters**, is the highest peak in Arunachal Pradesh and lies along the Indo-China border.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Sikkim’s Geography:**
 
 
• Sikkim is the smallest Indian state by population and the second smallest by area. It is bordered by Nepal, Bhutan, Tibet, and West Bengal, making it strategically significant.
 
• The state is known for its **rich biodiversity**, with over 5,000 species of flowering plants, 500 species of orchids, and rare fauna.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Facts about Kanchenjunga:**

 
 
• Kanchenjunga was first climbed in **1955** by a British expedition led by **George Band** and **Joe Brown**. However, climbers stopped short of the summit out of respect for local beliefs.
 
• It is a major attraction for trekkers and environmental enthusiasts due to its stunning landscapes and ecological significance.
 
 
 
• **Himalayan Range:**
 
 
• The Himalayas extend across five countries: **India**, **Nepal**, **Bhutan**, **China**, and **Pakistan**. They are home to some of the highest peaks, including Mount Everest.
 
• The Indian Himalayan region is divided into three sectors: **Western Himalayas**, **Central Himalayas**, and **Eastern Himalayas**. Sikkim lies in the Eastern Himalayas.
